Name: JP's Energy System (Add-on)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Energy System[/u][/color][/i][/b][/size][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because regaining life and energy by eating is already unusual, but for it to be instantaneous as well... That's really bad![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4][i][b][color=#00ffff]This mod is an add-on for my main mod, [/color][color=#ffff00]“Hardew Valley”[/color][color=#00ffff], which significantly increases the game's difficulty. [/color][/b][/i][/size][/font][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]However, you don't need to have Hardew Valley; you can use this mod on its own![/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Georgia]

[b][size=3]This mod changes how you gain energy and health, so that instead of receiving everything instantly, you will receive it over time.[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bJf9tCYb/Tuto_Stardew_Valleyaderado.gif[/img]


[size=3]It also modifies regeneration when resting in water, causing you to recover health more slowly, making it less rewarding. [/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/26N7Zcjx/Tuto_Stardew_Valleyaderado_3.gif[/img]


[size=4][color=#00ff00][b]The use of Scythe, weapons, and their special abilities will now also consume energy.[/b][/color][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Scythe: [/b]Normal 2 points, Gold 1.5 points, Iridium 1 point.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Sword: [/b]1 point.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Dagger: [/b]0.5 points; its 4-hit special attack also costs 0.5 points per hit (2 points total).[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Club: [/b]2 points; the special attack costs 3 points; spamming the attack also consumes 3 energy per hit. (Left-click after using the right-click)[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]


[i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/b][/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods [b][color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color][/b].
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.

[/size][/font]
